other_conditions: Applicant must be a female beneficiary
Applicant must be a domicile of Maharashtra

benefits_summary: Provides low‑interest loans up to ₹5,00,000 per Self‑Help Group (₹25,000 per beneficiary) at 5% interest for up to 3 years with no beneficiary contribution required.
